title: Anything Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Anything is a capable AI app builder with a native Postgres database, but it falls short on privacy, agent access, and mobile output. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Anything's three biggest gaps natively, private builds from the free tier instead of public-only, 62 platform-wide MCP tools instead of no agent surface, and native mobile apps instead of web-only, and it's a more complete platform overall: growth tooling, SEO, reusable standards, and human support are all things Anything doesn't offer at any tier. More options are listed in our[Anything alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/anything-alternatives) roundup.
